# SomaLab

> Evidence-based nutrition consulting and health coaching for Australians — personalised plans for sustainable fat loss, performance, and wellbeing.

SomaLab combines clinical laboratory science with nutrition consulting to deliver personalised, evidence-based coaching. Services include initial and follow-up consultations, a 12-week health optimisation program, meal planning, corporate wellness, and a health biomarker & blood analysis add-on. Based in Australia, serving Brisbane, Gold Coast, and clients Australia-wide.
